scoring_and_repeatability.reason: Table 5 publishes means and standard errors only.
scoring_and_repeatability.scientific_scoring: Parse thirty slope lines grouped by printed Precision and trial labels; compute mean and standard error over ten slopes per precision. Report differences from Table 5 descriptively. No tolerance-based pass/fail is supported.
scoring_and_repeatability.performance_scoring: For a future timed run, use full fixed-workload wall seconds. This is an execution metric, not a published energy-script score.
scoring_and_repeatability.seed_reason: Published code omits randomSeed argument to setVelocitiesToTemperature; no seed list or CLI seed option published. Distinct explicit seed identities cannot be verified from source or reproduced exactly.
scoring_and_repeatability.sampling_rules: Fixed ten independent initializations per precision, three precision modes; 1000 post-integration energy samples per trial; no scale search.
